import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt
forms={
 'gamma_exp': (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t) - (p[3]+p[4]*t)*A**p[5], [3,1,0.2,0.3,0.1,1.5]),
 'exp_t2': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)*(1+p[1]*t) - (p[3]+p[4]*t)*A**p[5], [3,0.3,0.1,0.3,0.1,1.5]),
 'exp_sq': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[2]*t**2)*(1+p[1]*t) - (p[3]+p[4]*t)*A**p[5], [3,0.3,0.05,0.3,0.1,1.5]),
 'sin': (lambda p: p[0]*np.sin(p[1]*t+p[2]) + p[3] - (p[4]+p[5]*t)*A**p[6], [2,0.5,0,1,0.1,0.1,1.5]),
}
for k,(f,p0) in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(6):
        pp=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.3*np.random.randn(len(p0)))
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, pp, max_nfev=5000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(k, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(y), np.round(best.x,4))
